mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, embed_model, chunk_config, status, doc_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, embed_model, chunk_config, status, doc_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT kb.id, kb.tenant_id AS "tenantId", kb.name, kb.description, kb.status, kb.doc_count AS "docCount", kb.created_by AS "createdBy", kb.created_at AS "createdAt", kb.updated_at AS "updatedAt", org.name AS "orgName", usr.username AS "creatorUsername" FROM kb_knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN sys_organization org ON org.org_id = kb.tenant_id LEFT JOIN biz_user_account usr ON usr.user_id = kb.created_by
ORDER BY kb.updated_at DESC, kb.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base (tenant_id, name, description, embed_model, chunk_config, status, doc_count, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{embedModel}, #{chunkConfig}::jsonb, #{status}, #{docCount}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET doc_count = #{docCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
